meta.title: Markdown Notes
meta.description: A local Markdown notes manager in the sidebar: folder tree, images and rich text, favorites, delete, an editable split view with collapsible file bar and draggable pane widths, a slash menu in both source and rendered views, per-code-block language switching with syntax highlighting, open-in-file-manager, drag-to-move, image resizing, synchronized scrolling, and character-accurate mirrored carets.
